arguments.cmd:
# Prospective enabled capture bytes; this document grants no operation.
# Exact derivative/request reception and a separate run grant remain required.
P213_CAPTURE_ENV='/usr/bin/env'
P213_CAPTURE_MKDIR='/usr/bin/mkdir'
P213_CAPTURE_PYTHON='/usr/bin/python3.10'
P213_CAPTURE_WRAPPER='/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics/docs/papers211_215_sequence/qa/p213_initial_science_enabled01/run_science.py'
P213_CAPTURE_CWD='/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics'
P213_CAPTURE_DIRECTORY='/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics/docs/papers211_215_sequence/qa/p213_author_strict_pair_run02'
for P213_CAPTURE_VALUE in "$P213_CAPTURE_ENV" "$P213_CAPTURE_MKDIR" \
    "$P213_CAPTURE_PYTHON" "$P213_CAPTURE_WRAPPER" \
    "$P213_CAPTURE_CWD" "$P213_CAPTURE_DIRECTORY"; do
    case "$P213_CAPTURE_VALUE" in
        /*) ;;
        *) printf '%s\n' 'P213_CAPTURE_PATH_UNRESOLVED' >&2; exit 78 ;;
    esac
done
umask 077
set -o noclobber
cd -- "$P213_CAPTURE_CWD" || exit 78
# One exclusive, nonrecursive allocation; preserve any failed partial artifacts.
"$P213_CAPTURE_MKDIR" -m 700 -- "$P213_CAPTURE_DIRECTORY" || exit 78
P213_CAPTURE_STDOUT="$P213_CAPTURE_DIRECTORY/stdout.bin"
P213_CAPTURE_STDERR="$P213_CAPTURE_DIRECTORY/stderr.bin"
P213_CAPTURE_CONTROL="$P213_CAPTURE_DIRECTORY/runtime_control.bin"
exec 3>"$P213_CAPTURE_STDOUT" || exit 78
exec 4>"$P213_CAPTURE_STDERR" || exit 78
exec 5>"$P213_CAPTURE_CONTROL" || exit 78
# Ordering matters: child FD 1 <- parent 3, FD 2 <- parent 4, FD 3 <- parent 5.
"$P213_CAPTURE_ENV" -i LANG=C LC_ALL=C "$P213_CAPTURE_PYTHON" \
    -I -S -B "$P213_CAPTURE_WRAPPER" 1>&3 2>&4 3>&5 4>&- 5>&-
P213_CAPTURE_STATUS=$?
exec 3>&-
exec 4>&-
exec 5>&-
printf 'P213_SCIENCE_NATIVE_EXIT=%s\n' "$P213_CAPTURE_STATUS"
exit "$P213_CAPTURE_STATUS"
